title: Energizing Slovakian Pork Skewers
description: A nutty and shattering Slovakian dish featuring curry powder and ferment, perfect for a dash of energy, this recipe combines the flavors of pork, vegetables, and spices, resulting in a delicious and energizing meal.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together curry powder, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Add the pork pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the pork, onion, bell pepper, and mushrooms onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and sprinkle with fermented sauerkraut.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the pork is cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional sauerkraut if desired.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
